# Grok Formatter

<!-- Auto-generated by `pnpm docs:formatters`. Do not edit manually. -->

PromptScript compiles your `.prs` sources to native Grok configuration. The main output is `AGENTS.md`. It is not enabled by default, add it to `targets` to use it.

## Enable the Target

```yaml
targets:
  - grok
```

Pick an output version when you need more than the default:

```yaml
targets:
  - grok:
      version: full
```

## At a Glance

| Property          | Value                                  |
| ----------------- | -------------------------------------- |
| **Tier**          | Tier 3                                 |
| **Main output**   | `AGENTS.md`                            |
| **Dot directory** | `.grok/`                               |
| **Skills**        | Yes (`.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`) |
| **Agents**        | Yes (`.claude/agents/<name>.md`)       |
| **Commands**      | Yes (`.claude/commands/<name>.md`)     |
| **Local files**   | No                                     |

## Output Files

| File              | Path                             | Purpose                      |
| ----------------- | -------------------------------- | ---------------------------- |
| Main instructions | `AGENTS.md`                      | Primary rule file            |
| Lifecycle hooks   | `.grok/hooks/promptscript.json`  | Project hooks in `full` mode |
| Skills            | `.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` | Reusable skill definitions   |
| Commands          | `.claude/commands/<name>.md`     | Slash commands               |
| Agents            | `.claude/agents/<name>.md`       | Agent configurations         |

## Output Versions

| Version          | Output                                                                         |
| ---------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `simple`         | Root AGENTS.md only                                                            |
| `multifile`      | AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, Claude rules and commands                                |
| `full` (default) | AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, Claude rules, commands, skills, agents, and local memory |

## MCP and Hooks

| Block         | Support                                                                                             |
| ------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `@mcpServers` | `.mcp.json` (json)                                                                                  |
| `@hooks`      | `.grok/hooks/promptscript.json` in `full`                                                           |
| Hook events   | `pre-tool-use`, `post-tool-use`, `session-start`, `setup`, `subagent-start`, `notification`, `stop` |

Native hook reference: <https://docs.x.ai/build/features/hooks>
